text:
elsa: opened PR #4321 to clarify Aurorax-quant memory behavior + fix embed truncation example. quick review requested, especially perf numbers and SDK snippet. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

mohit: will take a look. quick q — is this specifically about OOMs when seq_len > 2048 or a general regression?

elsa: mostly OOMs / big latency spikes past 2k. noticed customers hitting it when they switch to quantized variants without adjusting cache settings. PR has a short note and an example that recommends prefix caching.

mohit: ok. left a tiny inline note suggesting showing the SDK param rather than a CLI snippet. e.g.:
```js
const res = await client.generate({
  model: "aurorax-quant",
  input: userPrompt,
  max_cache_tokens: 4096, // helps long-context workloads
});
```

karen: I can reword the doc copy to be less scary, but we need a small bench table to justify the 2048 cutoff. @samir can you share a quick csv or numbers I can paste?

samir: ran a quick sweep on p4d (8xA100), aurorax-quant, batch=1:
- seq=1024: 120ms median
- seq=2048: 150ms median
- seq=4096: 420ms median (without prefix cache)
I'll upload the CSV to gdrive in a min: https://drive.google.com/shortlink/aurorax-quant-bench.csv

jenna: note for SDK docs — SDK v3.1 renames a couple cache flags, we now prefer `max_cache_tokens` rather than `cache_window`. if the PR uses the old name we should change it. Also the embed example used `truncate: true` — that should be `truncate_front: true` for consistent behavior.

elsa: thanks. can we also add a compatibility note that certain adapter-variants (low-bit adapters) may not support streaming fallback? small line under "compatibility" so customers know why they might see higher latency.

mohit: good call. maybe: "Low-bit adapter variants may disable some kernel-level streaming optimizations; prefer dedicated or the non-quantized variant for low-latency long-context workloads." Keep it short.

karen: i'll add a two-row table and that compatibility sentence. also will swap to the SDK snippet and update the embed example. planning to push an update to the PR by EOD.

docbot: docs-lint: passed ✅ preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/4321/ (staging)

samir: uploaded csv and a tiny plot: https://drive.google.com/aurorax-quant-bench.csv and https://drive.google.com/aurorax-quant-plot.png

karen: grabbed the CSV and copied a tiny summary into the PR. changed wording to "noticeable latency increase past 2k tokens on quantized variants unless caching is enabled." also added the SDK snippet Mohit suggested.

jenna: looks good. left one nit about the code fence language (js) and a small wording tweak for the embed option.

elsa: sweet. thanks everyone. i'll merge after CI preview smoke and a quick docs owner + product ack. if no objections by tomorrow morning i'll merge. :shipit: 

mohit: +1

samir: +1

karen: +1

elsa: (added a tiny follow-up) can we add a one-sentence migration note for customers on Dedicated to temporarily pin the non-quant variant while they evaluate? i can add that in a follow-up if you prefer.

karen: i can append it in the same PR, short note under "migration guidance".

elsa: perfect, thanks."
